scope_interpretation: Newest explicit instruction: five different daily zodiac carousels, exactly two humorous and three non-humorous. Each zodiac carousel has six cards, exactly two different signs per card, and covers all 12 signs exactly once. This replaces only the earlier zodiac count/structure. Together with the preserved four emotional-fiction slots and one Greece-versus-country comparison, the daily target is ten logical posts and forty provider deliveries.

series.sources: Use credible primary sources, comparable definitions and years, dates of data, and clear gross/net and purchasing-power distinctions. Never fabricate numbers or national stereotypes. Store sources with the post and include them in the caption/description.

formats.facebook: Native POST with all separate square photo cards, not a Reel substitute.

Silent is permitted for these non-narrated series. If music is used it must be a single rights-cleared and actually reviewed instrumental layer.

quality_gates.before_every_create: Repeat live duplicate and concurrent-session checks comparing series, substantive plot/topic, title, hook, caption, fingerprint, numbering and exact media hashes. Existing correct Published or active Scheduled-PENDING provider deliveries must not be recreated.
quality_gates.dedupe: One original logical story may be sent once to each of the four platforms. Do not recycle it on another day, even with different images or title. Select a genuinely different replacement for duplicate topics.
quality_gates.exact_final_review: Inspect all the actual final images/videos, Greek text, spelling, order, card count, scene relevance, crop, mobile readability, CTA, caption, hashtags, duration, actual audio where present, platform format and AI/fiction disclosure. Metadata, render success or an old approval do not pass QA. Bind PASSED_FINAL_REVIEW to the exact hashes.
quality_gates.after_every_write: Immediately read back brand, date, local time, timezone, providers, media, draft, autoPublish, IDs, UUIDs and each provider status. PENDING is not Published. Retry only a failed provider after verifying no publication occurred.
quality_gates.unresolved_source_disagreement: Do not publish uncertain material. Reconcile the specific disagreement with current evidence.
